# Phase shifters and switches (generated by switches.py)

For each clean shifter (a crossing, or an absorption) in which an input T survives (same glider type in and out), T's seed event moves by Delta. A later partner Z that would have met T in class k then meets it in class pi(k). Only partners with >= 2 classes can be affected; partners Z are base gliders and A^2..A^5, B^2, B^3. Listed: reactions whose pi is not the identity for some Z, with the outcome changes (k: outcome -> pi(k): outcome).
